events.title: NMI Holdings Q1 Earnings, Revenues Top, Insurance in Force Rises Y/Y
events.body: NMIH tops Q1 estimates as revenues rise 5.8% and primary insurance in force climbs to $222.3B, even as persistency slips and claims surge.

events.title: Hanover Insurance Q1 Earnings Top Estimates on Lower Cat Losses
events.body: The Hanover Insurance Group's Q1 operating EPS rose 36% to $5.25, beating estimates as pricing and loss trends drove a record 20.3% ROE.

events.title: Kinsale Capital Group Q1 Earnings Call Highlights
events.body: Kinsale Capital Group (NYSE:KNSL) reported strong profitability in the first quarter of 2026 despite a slight decline in gross written premium, as management pointed to competitive conditions in parts of the excess and surplus (E&S) market :

events.title: KNSL Q1 Estimates Beat on Strong Underwriting, Revenues Rise Y/Y
events.body: Kinsale Q1 earnings beat estimates as EPS jumps 37.7% on strong premiums and underwriting gains, despite higher expenses and a dip in gross premiums.
